newsitem.title: USA: Barnett to acquire Republic Banking.
newsitem.headline: Barnett to acquire Republic Banking.

text.p: Barnett Banks Inc., the largest Florida banking company, said Thursday it has agreed in principle to acquire Republic Banking Corp.

Republic Banking is the holding company for Republic National Bank of Miami, which operates 25 offices mainly in Dade County, Fla. Founded in 1965, Republic has total assets of $1.5 billion and deposits of $1.3 billion.
The agreement is subject to the completion of due diligence and the approval by both companies' boards of directors.
Barnett, based in Jacksonville, Fla., is among the nation's 25 largest financial institutions, with assets of more than $40 billion.
Barnett's stock rose 12.5 cents to $50.75 on the New York Stock Exchange.
